odi: Heads-up: ran into a nasty DX issue in the retriever sampleapp combining the batch helper + rerank path + auth-refresh. Result: missing vectors, mismatched dims, and occasional top-level list responses depending on SDK.

jamie: ugh, can you summarise exact symptoms and what you changed to repro?

odi: Repro steps: 11 docs, batchingHelper batch_size=4. Force auth rotation mid-flight (short TTL token). Node client (0.11.3) sometimes returns 10 vectors (one missing) and vec_dim=512; Python client (0.9.5) returns 11 vectors with vec_dim=768. Also sometimes node returns a plain array for embeddings instead of {"embeddings": [...]}. This breaks our merging logic in sampleapp and throws off rerank scores.

rk: two separate problems: 1) queue mutation + retry -> missing/duplicate entries; 2) parity + routing -> dim mismatch and response-shape diffs. Do you have logs?

odi: logs (sanitized):
```
[2030-06-12T11:18:02Z] batching: queued batch0 ids=[0,1,2,3]
[2030-06-12T11:18:02Z] batching: queued batch1 ids=[4,5,6,7]
[2030-06-12T11:18:03Z] auth: token refresh start
[2030-06-12T11:18:03Z] embeddings: send batch0 snapshot_ids=[0,1,2,3]
[2030-06-12T11:18:04Z] embeddings: 401 auth -> retry (snapshot present)
[2030-06-12T11:18:04Z] embeddings: send batch0 (retry) snapshot_ids=[0,1,2,3]
[2030-06-12T11:18:05Z] embeddings: response len=3 dim=512 // server returned only 3 vectors for 4 inputs
[2030-06-12T11:18:05Z] batching: added doc id=10 as new batch2
[2030-06-12T11:18:06Z] final: merged count=10 expected=11
```

rk: That response len=3 is the key. Either server dropped one input during retry or client truncated slice. Also the dim=512 hints that retry was routed to a different variant (quantized) for cost. If the model alias allows multiple variants we must guarantee same dim.

jamie: short-term fixes: (A) change batching helper to snapshot [{id, text}] before calling the network so retries reuse exact payloads, (B) normalize SDK responses: always return object with "embeddings" key and keep order by ids, (C) add unit/e2e that simulates token rotation mid-send and asserts final merged length == original.

odi: implemented (A) and (B) in my branch: https://github.com/redwoodinc/sampleapp/pull/1337. Added a unit test that mocks auth and forces retry; local run resolves missing-vector in most runs.

rk: long-term: add model alias contract in model catalog enforcing `output_dim` and add a router rule: retries must stick to same model variant or the server must adapt outputs to contract. I'll file a model-catalog RFC.

ci-bot: queued canary build for branch odi/batch-snapshot (build 4876).

jamie: docs action items: update onboarding "Embedding parity gotchas" with 1) batch-snapshot recommendation, 2) how auth rotations can interact with batching, 3) how to verify vec dims. Also add a troubleshooting checklist for "missing vector vs dim flip".

odi: note to self: ensure sampleapp uses item ids to merge results, not positions. That makes final merge robust against ordering changes.

rk: agree. Also add a server-side validation that rejects responses with mixed dims in the same batch; log a routing decision if retry goes to a different variant.

odi: TL;DR: cause = retry + mutable queue + nondeterministic routing; mitigation = snapshot sub-batches, normalize SDK shapes, enforce model alias dims + tests/docs. I'll merge after CI green.
